boards.title: Your First Weekend at Stevens Institute of Technology, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for learning campus, finding student resources and taking in Hoboken’s waterfront.

cards.entity_name: Stevens Institute of Technology Virtual Campus Tour
cards.title: Start with the campus map
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · orient yourself before wandering
cards.notes: Open the interactive tour, identify your residence, dining and library stops, then use it to make a short first walk across campus.
cards.short_summary: A visual, map-based first look at Stevens’ campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens offers an interactive campus map and tour with videos, photos and campus-map navigation.
cards.source_title: Visit Us | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Available online; no physical-access claim is made.

cards.title: Get your bearings at the UCC
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus hub
cards.notes: Enter through the Grand Commons, note the Welcome Desk, and spot the study, lounge, dining and student-organization spaces for later.
cards.short_summary: A central Stevens hub for student life, dining and study.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Center Complex includes spaces for socialization, studying, dining and relaxation, plus a Welcome Desk in the Grand Commons.
cards.source_title: University Center Complex | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The Welcome Desk is inside the University Center; building hours are listed by Stevens and may change.

cards.title: Have a first campus meal at Pierce
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Wesley J. Howe Center
cards.notes: Use your eligible meal option or purchase a meal, then take a moment to learn where the central dining hall sits in your campus routine.
cards.short_summary: Stevens’ central dining hall and a practical first meal stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens identifies Pierce Dining Hall as the central dining hall for its dining program.
cards.source_title: Dining at Stevens | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Dining access and payment depend on current dining arrangements.

cards.title: Find the library before you need it
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · campus study stop
cards.notes: Locate the library, choose a future study seat and browse its digital collections for a quick window into Stevens history and student life.
cards.short_summary: A study destination with Stevens archival and digital collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens’ Digital Collections portal offers digitized photographs, manuscripts, The Stute collection and Voices from Castle Point.
cards.source_title: Digital Collections Portal | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Check current library access policies before visiting in person.

cards.title: Pause at America’s Cup
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Samuel C. Williams Library
cards.notes: Use the café as a brief reset while you are in the library; confirm the current menu and hours before relying on it for a meal.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee-and-pastry café located in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens lists America’s Cup among its on-campus dining options and describes coffee and pastries there.
cards.source_title: Dining at Stevens | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Purchases and operating hours vary; verify before going.

cards.entity_name: Charles V. Schaefer, Jr. Athletic and Recreation Center
cards.title: Locate recreation options
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · campus activity stop
cards.notes: Find the recreation center and review current eligibility, equipment and program information before planning a workout or recreational activity.
cards.short_summary: Stevens’ named athletic and recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens identifies the Charles V. Schaefer, Jr. Athletic and Recreation Center as a campus facility for students.
cards.source_title: Life at Pre-College | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Facility access is subject to current Stevens recreation policies.

cards.title: Browse an organization or event
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · choose one interest to explore
cards.notes: Use the Undergraduate Student Life portal to scan upcoming events or organizations, then bookmark one group or activity to revisit this week.
cards.short_summary: A starting point for Stevens student organizations and events.
cards.evidence_claim: Undergraduate Student Life states that Stevens has about 150 student organizations and supports student involvement opportunities.
cards.source_title: Undergraduate Student Life | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Event participation and organization membership may have separate requirements.

cards.title: Take in Castle Point
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · campus overlook
cards.notes: Walk the campus grounds at a comfortable pace and use the overlook to connect the hilltop campus with the Hudson River and Manhattan skyline.
cards.short_summary: The historic Stevens setting above the Hudson River.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens describes its campus as situated on a bluff overlooking the Hudson River and the Manhattan skyline.
cards.source_title: Visit Us | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Stay on open, permitted campus paths and follow posted guidance.

cards.title: Continue to Pier A Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Hoboken waterfront
cards.notes: Head to the waterfront park for its lawn, gazebo and river setting; bring a friend, keep the plan simple and observe posted park rules.
cards.short_summary: A named Hoboken waterfront park with a lawn and gazebo.
cards.evidence_claim: Hoboken lists Pier A Park at 100 Sinatra Drive and identifies its great lawn, gazebo and fishing access.
cards.source_title: Pier A Park | City of Hoboken
cards.access_notes: Use public park areas and follow current City of Hoboken rules.

cards.title: End with a Washington Street dinner
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Hoboken neighborhood walk
cards.notes: Choose a food option that fits your budget and dietary needs, then walk the active commercial corridor with friends and a plan for getting home.
cards.short_summary: A Hoboken restaurant corridor near Stevens.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens describes Washington Street as a Hoboken area with a wide range of restaurant cuisines.
cards.source_title: Right at Home in Hoboken | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Individual businesses set their own prices, hours and access policies.
